stories.headline: A medieval Bulgarian tsar's remains come home
stories.summary: Samuel ruled the First Bulgarian Empire and died in 1014. After decades of negotiation with Greece, his remains were transferred to Sofia on 3 October and placed in a sarcophagus in the Saint Sophia Church. His grave had been found in 1965 on an island in Lake Prespa.

stories.headline: Michael J. Fox is promoted within the Order of Canada
stories.summary: The actor Michael J. Fox has been promoted to companion level within the Order of Canada. The governor general, Louise Arbour, recognised his advocacy on Parkinson's disease and research. Fox had been an Officer of the order since 2010.

stories.headline: Argentina offers citizenship for a large payment
stories.summary: Argentina has introduced a programme that lets foreigners obtain citizenship by paying into the state. One route is a contribution of US$350,000 to the Ministry of Economy; the other is $800,000 placed in a seven-year government bond. Spouses and children require lower additional payments.

stories.headline: Tiny fossils hint at an ancient sense of direction
stories.summary: Tiny magnetic fossils, 97 million years old, were preserved in ancient seafloor sediments. Researchers now think the structures worked as a navigation system, letting an ancient animal read Earth's magnetic field much like a map. Which creature made them is still unknown.
